Subject: Standby node certification & Epsilon Dataworks — quick availability ask

Team —

Epsilon (Elaine + Ben on cc below) are two weeks out from contract signature and asked us to certify a standby buffer for their dedicated pool. They need a formal go/no-go on a soft hold for the following profile so sales can commit to the timeline in the SOW:

- Profile: 8x A100-80GB equivalent per pod, with at least one hot spare node per pod
- Expected steady-state: 12k requests/day, median seq len 1024, spikes to 40k/day during training windows
- Duration: Q1 onboarding ramp (90 days) with potential sustained committed pool thereafter
- Required: 72-hour pre-commit hold window, and ability to convert to dedicated reserved capacity within 14 days of signature

Ask: Can ops confirm current available nodes by region (us-west/us-east), whether we can mark a 72-hour soft hold, and any constraints on preemption or slice-sharing with other customers? Also please attach the capacity snapshot you can share with Epsilon (redacted OK).

Im copying Rishi and Karthik for SRE-sell input and to prep a brief for leadership if there is any risk to other late-stage deals.

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa —

Snapshot summary (us regions) attached: gpu_capacity_snapshot_20291103.csv. High level:
- Us-west: 42 A100-equivalent nodes idle pool; 6 currently earmarked for short-term POC bursts (can be reclaimed with 48h notice)
- Us-east: 28 A100-equivalent nodes idle; 4 in maintenance this week
- Hot-spare policy: we can reserve 1 hot spare per pod within a soft hold, but it counts against available nodes for other immediate allocations
- Preemption: on our hosted fabric, we can implement a 72-hour soft hold flagged in inventory; it is enforced by ops but not billing-reserved until conversion to a dedicated contract

Constraints and notes:
- If Epsilon wants guaranteed non-preemptible physical isolation (no slice-sharing), we need a formal Dedicated commit and 14d lead time to pin images and perform QA
- If we establish the soft hold now, it will block public assignment but can be released automatically if a higher-priority reserved contract is signed elsewhere
- I can lock the 72-hour window starting 2029-11-04T00:00:00Z; confirm and I will push the soft hold ticket and attach the redacted snapshot for Sales

Attachments: gpu_capacity_snapshot_20291103.csv

— Dev Patel
